products.summary: K&F's 1-to-5-stop variable ND with hard stops at both ends and a titanium True Color coating, in the 67 mm size most kit zooms and primes use. It keeps you out of the X-pattern zone and costs less than half of the PolarPro Edition II.
products.fit: Video shooters on a 67 mm lens who want a 1-to-5-stop VND with hard stops for under $110, and hybrid shooters who also want the ND2 position for overcast or indoor video at f/1.8.
caveats: 5 stops is the ceiling; bright midday scenes at wide apertures need a fixed ND or a second filter.
Lens hoods do not fit over it, and the cap size goes up one step to 72 mm.
Independent lab tests of the True Color version are scarce; the color claim rests on K&F's page and owner reviews.
Standard shipping is $9.90 unless the order reaches the free-shipping threshold ($79 for guests).
